Caridad Restaurant.name: Caridad Restaurant
Caridad Restaurant.note: Dominican comfort food, brunch/lunch/dinner, delivery and takeout. 3533 Broadway, Washington Heights. Community staple for decades.

Nom Wah Tea Parlor.name: Nom Wah Tea Parlor
Nom Wah Tea Parlor.note: NYC's oldest dim sum restaurant (est. 1920). 13 Doyers St. Freshly made dim sum 10:30am–9pm daily, not just weekends. Most dishes $5–$12. Classic family destination.

El Nuevo Caribeño.name: El Nuevo Caribeño
El Nuevo Caribeño.note: Pan-Caribbean institution in El Barrio for 30+ years. Pollo a la brasa, pernil, mofongo. 1675 Lexington Ave at 105th St. Uber Eats listing shows prices.

Desi Stop and Deli.name: Desi Stop and Deli
Desi Stop and Deli.note: Samosa burger $5.99, veggie burger $5.99, curry/rice combo $5.99, full platter $12.99, palak paneer $15.99. Open 24 hours at 2nd Ave, East Village. Cash discount available.

Balade.name: Balade
Balade.note: Chicken shawarma sandwich $15, shish tawook sandwich $15, falafel sandwich $14, meat shawarma $17, hummus $13. BYOB. 208 1st Ave, East Village. Mon–Thu/Sun, full menu visible online.

Yemen Café & Restaurant.name: Yemen Café & Restaurant
Yemen Café & Restaurant.note: Full Yemeni menu online with prices. Chicken plates $27.99, soups $4.49, appetizers under $20. Halal. Very family-oriented.

Nish Nush.name: Nish Nush
Nish Nush.note: Classic falafel sandwich $12.50, deluxe sandwich $14.50, sabich $14.50, chili falafel burger $19, falafel platter ~$15. 88 Reade St (and John St). Bright, family-welcoming space.

Pisillo Italian Panini.name: Pisillo Italian Panini
Pisillo Italian Panini.note: Artisanal Italian panini $13.90–$18.90; vegetarian options from $13.90. Cash only, ATM on-site. 97 Nassau St, Financial District. Generous portions, popular with office workers and families.

Bamboo Walk Caribbean Restaurant.name: Bamboo Walk Caribbean Restaurant
Bamboo Walk Caribbean Restaurant.note: Full menu online with prices. Jerk chicken meal $13.95, curry goat $21.95, bamboo pasta $11.95. Outdoor seating available.

Veselka.name: Veselka
Veselka.note: Borscht, pierogies, kielbasa, chicken paprikash, chicken schnitzel, beef stroganoff. Breakfast from $7.75. Open 24/7 at 144 2nd Ave, East Village. NYC institution since 1954.

MangoSeed.name: MangoSeed
MangoSeed.note: Caribbean-American restaurant near Kings Theatre. Brunch and dinner. Family-run with warm neighborhood vibe.

Flor de Mayo (UWS).name: Flor de Mayo (UWS)
Flor de Mayo (UWS).note: Peruvian pollo a la brasa, lo mein, fried rice, combo platters $13–$20. 484 Amsterdam Ave (UWS location). Founded 1977 by Peruvian immigrants. Family-style portions.

Flor de Mayo (Upper Manhattan Broadway).name: Flor de Mayo (Upper Manhattan Broadway)
Flor de Mayo (Upper Manhattan Broadway).note: Second listing for the upper Broadway location at 4160 Broadway. Peruvian rotisserie chicken, Chinese-Peruvian stir-fries, combination platters. Founded by Peruvian immigrants in 1977.

items.item: Ropa vieja, yellow rice and salad

Mirna's Pupuseria.name: Mirna's Pupuseria
Mirna's Pupuseria.note: Pupusas (order of two) $10.99–$12.79. Widely considered best pupusa spot in Brooklyn.

East Harbor Seafood Palace.name: East Harbor Seafood Palace
East Harbor Seafood Palace.note: Major Sunset Park dim sum destination. Dim sum items $6.95–$17.95; dinner entrées typically $14–$24.

L&B Spumoni Gardens.name: L&B Spumoni Gardens
L&B Spumoni Gardens.note: Iconic since 1939. Slice $4.50, Sicilian pie $35. Pasta entrées $15.95–$24.95. Chicken entrées $25.95. Children's menu available.

items.item: L&b famous sicilian with vodka sauce

Hometown Bar-B-Que.name: Hometown Bar-B-Que
Hometown Bar-B-Que.note: Pit-smoked BBQ. Pulled pork $11.50, beef rib $18.50, pulled pork sandwich $21. Kids love it. Large open space.

Nick's Restaurant & Pizzeria.name: Nick's Restaurant & Pizzeria
Nick's Restaurant & Pizzeria.note: Chicken francese $23, chicken marsala $23, spaghetti pomodoro $18, old-fashioned pizza $21, calzone $16. Brick-oven Italian at 94th & 2nd Ave. Consistently family-friendly.

Puerto Viejo Dominican Bistro.name: Puerto Viejo Dominican Bistro
Puerto Viejo Dominican Bistro.note: Family-owned Dominican since 1986. Lunch plates $9–$12, dinner $10–$25. Highly rated. Accepts cash only.

Roll 'N' Roaster.name: Roll 'N' Roaster
Roll 'N' Roaster.note: Full menu online. Roast beef sandwich $8.95–$9.45, chicken tenders $9.45, burgers $7.45–$9.45. Open since 1971. Iconic family spot.

Homemade Taqueria.name: Homemade Taqueria
Homemade Taqueria.note: Fresh ingredients, street-style tacos $4.50–$4.75, burritos $12–$15, 3 birria tacos with consomé $15.95.

Taqueria Al Pastor.name: Taqueria Al Pastor
Taqueria Al Pastor.note: Authentic Mexican tacos ~$10.35 each online. Counter-service style with BYOB policy. Under $15 for a full meal.

Zaab Zaab.name: Zaab Zaab
Zaab Zaab.note: OpenTable-rated 4.8 Exceptional; bold Isan Thai flavors. Pad Thai, Tom Yum, Khao Soi Beef Shank.

Cuts & Slices.name: Cuts & Slices
Cuts & Slices.note: Full menu online. Cheese slice $3.50, specialty oxtail/jerk/curry slices $7.50–$12.50. Innovative Brooklyn pizza with Caribbean flair.

Matteo's of Howard Beach.name: Matteo's of Howard Beach
Matteo's of Howard Beach.note: Family-style Italian; homemade pasta made daily, baked clams, classic red-sauce Italian.

La Villa Pizzeria.name: La Villa Pizzeria
La Villa Pizzeria.note: Local Howard Beach classic. Baked clams $9, pasta dishes $13–$18, calzones, wood-fired pizza.

Tatiana Restaurant.name: Tatiana Restaurant
Tatiana Restaurant.note: Waterfront café with outdoor seating. Russian-American menu. Quaint family-friendly café; weekday entrées under $25.

Peaches.name: Peaches
Peaches.note: Full menu online with prices. Southern comfort food. Fried chicken sandwich $18.95, turkey meatloaf $17.95–$21.95. Children welcome.

SHI Eurasia.name: SHI Eurasia
SHI Eurasia.note: Pan-Asian with sushi; mapo tofu $15, noodle soups $11–$16, chicken dishes $16–$18. Waterfront views.

Spy C Cuisine.name: Spy C Cuisine
Spy C Cuisine.note: Michelin Bib Gourmand 2021. Mapo tofu $15.95, braised pork belly $19.95, scallion pancake $6.95. Lunch specials $10.95.

Rincon Colombiano.name: Rincon Colombiano
Rincon Colombiano.note: Traditional Colombian plates $17–$22, all include 3 sides and a free soda. Arroz Con Pollo $18.99.

Dee's Wood Fired Pizza & Kitchen.name: Dee's Wood Fired Pizza & Kitchen
Dee's Wood Fired Pizza & Kitchen.note: Wood-fired artisan pizza; popular with families. Some entrees above $25 (chicken milanese $27).

Erawan Thai Cuisine.name: Erawan Thai Cuisine
Erawan Thai Cuisine.note: Full priced menu online. Pad Thai $18, Mussaman Curry $23, Tom Yum $9, Satay $11. #1 family restaurant Bayside on TripAdvisor.

Zaab Zaab Woodside.name: Zaab Zaab Woodside
Zaab Zaab Woodside.note: OpenTable 4.8 Exceptional rating. Bold Isan Thai; dine-in, takeout, or delivery. Brunch on weekends.

Cafe Colonial Restaurant & Grill.name: Cafe Colonial Restaurant & Grill
Cafe Colonial Restaurant & Grill.note: Full online ordering menu with prices. Lunch specials $12–$14. Dinner entrées (churrasco, pernil, camarofongo) $22–$24.

Pio Pio.name: Pio Pio
Pio Pio.note: Famous rotisserie chicken; quarter $7.95, half $10.25, whole $15.25. Sides $3.50–$6.50.

Taqueria Corona.name: Taqueria Corona
Taqueria Corona.note: Full sit-down Mexican; entree platters $15–$24, kids meal $7.95, tacos $4.75–$5.50 each.

Sangria Cafe.name: Sangria Cafe
Sangria Cafe.note: Full menu with prices online. Mofongo $25, arroz con pollo $25, pork chops $29, lechon $27. Lunch specials $14–$20. Family-friendly.

Loukoumi Taverna.name: Loukoumi Taverna
Loukoumi Taverna.note: Detailed menu with prices online. Lunch platters $13–$21, charcoal grills $17–$27. Chicken souvlaki $17.

Stamatis Restaurant.name: Stamatis Restaurant
Stamatis Restaurant.note: Astoria institution. Moussaka $20, roasted chicken $17, pastitsio $18, pork souvlaki $18.50.

Dominick's Restaurant.name: Dominick's Restaurant
Dominick's Restaurant.note: No printed menu — waiter recites daily specials. Legendary family Italian institution on Arthur Ave. Cash only. Family-style dining.

Roberto's Restaurant.name: Roberto's Restaurant
Roberto's Restaurant.note: Classic Arthur Ave Italian, highly regarded. Pasta, veal, chicken entrées. Family-run neighborhood institution.

Antonio's Trattoria.name: Antonio's Trattoria
Antonio's Trattoria.note: TripAdvisor recommended. Moderately priced Italian near Arthur Ave. Family-friendly, 247 reviews.

Chavela's.name: Chavela's
Chavela's.note: Full menu online. Tacos $4 at happy hour, mains $15–$22. Mexican cuisine with local following.

Pio Pio (Forest Hills).name: Pio Pio (Forest Hills)
Pio Pio (Forest Hills).note: Forest Hills location of the famous Peruvian rotisserie. Same menu as Jackson Heights; quarter chicken $7.95.

Kingsbridge Social Club.name: Kingsbridge Social Club
Kingsbridge Social Club.note: Neighborhood restaurant hideaway near 1 train. Reservations for parties >4. Family-friendly neighborhood spot.

Zero Otto Nove.name: Zero Otto Nove
Zero Otto Nove.note: Well-regarded Arthur Ave Italian. Wood-fired Neapolitan pizza, pasta. Listed on Bronx Little Italy official site. Independent family-run.

SoBro Garden.name: SoBro Garden
SoBro Garden.note: Family-friendly, event-capable venue. Authentic Latin favorites. Happy hour until 8pm weekdays. $35 prix-fixe during Bronx Restaurant Week.

Colima Taqueria.name: Colima Taqueria
Colima Taqueria.note: Mexican taqueria on Arthur Ave corridor. Tacos, burritos, quesadillas. Family-friendly neighborhood taqueria.

Ihawan.name: Ihawan
Ihawan.note: Full menu with prices on website. Pork BBQ meal $14, chicken BBQ $14, sizzling sisig $20, lechon kawali $15.

Emilio's of Morris Park.name: Emilio's of Morris Park
Emilio's of Morris Park.note: Voted top 25 pizza in NYC by NY Times. Chicken parmigiana $21, pasta $17–$24, pizza slice ~$6. Family-friendly neighborhood landmark.

San Jeronimo Restaurant & Bakery.name: San Jeronimo Restaurant & Bakery
San Jeronimo Restaurant & Bakery.note: Authentic Mexican with bakery. Open daily 10am–10pm. Part of the vibrant Latino community corridor on Port Richmond Ave.

G&G American Grill.name: G&G American Grill
G&G American Grill.note: Independent family diner. Gyro platter $17.95, dinner specials $18.95–$21.95, wraps $14.95. Greek and American comfort food. Breakfast and lunch all day.

Liebman's Deli.name: Liebman's Deli
Liebman's Deli.note: Classic Bronx institution. Pastrami/corned beef sandwiches, brisket, deli classics. Online ordering menu. Family-friendly neighborhood deli.

Wicked Wolf Bronx.name: Wicked Wolf Bronx
Wicked Wolf Bronx.note: Local East Tremont American bar and grill. Neighborhood spot for burgers, comfort food.

Caridad at Kingsbridge.name: Caridad at Kingsbridge
Caridad at Kingsbridge.note: Dominican family restaurant. Menu categories include mofongos, meats, seafood, Mexican corner, Italian cuisine. Open Sun–Fri 7am–12am, Sat 7am–1am.

Sabrosura Restaurant.name: Sabrosura Restaurant
Sabrosura Restaurant.note: 30+ year staple. Unique Latin Caribbean–Chinese fusion. Featured on Uber Eats. Family-friendly neighborhood classic.

Holland Bay Restaurant.name: Holland Bay Restaurant
Holland Bay Restaurant.note: Authentic Caribbean restaurant. Jerk chicken, curry goat, oxtail. Medium plates $8.50–$10.95, large plates $11.50–$15.95. Very affordable, family-friendly.

Patsy's Pizzeria (Morris Park).name: Patsy's Pizzeria (Morris Park)
Patsy's Pizzeria (Morris Park).note: Historic Bronx pizzeria. Online menu with prices and online ordering. Pizza slices ~$6, pies $10.95+, entrees. Family neighborhood classic.

Wonderful Chinese Restaurant.name: Wonderful Chinese Restaurant
Wonderful Chinese Restaurant.note: Full online menu with prices. Lo mein $7–$8, chicken dishes $8–$10, house specials $15–$17. Lunch specials $9.25. Very affordable.

Trattoria Toscana.name: Trattoria Toscana
Trattoria Toscana.note: Family Italian trattoria in Great Kills, indoor and outdoor dining available. Pasta, chicken, and veal dishes typically under $25.

'O Sfizio Ristorante.name: 'O Sfizio Ristorante
'O Sfizio Ristorante.note: Upscale Neapolitan Italian. Pizzas $14–$18, cheese ravioli $19, spaghetti puttanesca $23, cavatelli $25. Chicken any style $25. Veal/seafood Secondi are $27–$49. Best value: pizza, pasta, and panini/b

Nino's Restaurant.name: Nino's Restaurant
Nino's Restaurant.note: Upscale Italian. Pasta dishes $21–$26 (mostly under $25), chicken parm $28, veal francese $31. Best ordered for pasta — penne, rigatoni, linguine all under $25. Full dinner menu online. NOTE: Secondi

Green Garden SI.name: Green Garden SI
Green Garden SI.note: Chinese restaurant on Forest Ave in West Brighton. Family-style Chinese. Online ordering available. Entrees typically $10–$18.

El Patron Mexican Restaurant (Stapleton).name: El Patron Mexican Restaurant (Stapleton)
El Patron Mexican Restaurant (Stapleton).note: Popular Mexican restaurant. Tacos, guacamole, street corn. Family-friendly. Also has second location at 1491 Hylan Blvd (Dongan Hills).

Marmar Restaurant.name: Marmar Restaurant
Marmar Restaurant.note: Unique Haitian-Mediterranean restaurant in West Brighton. Authentic Caribbean cuisine with wine/beer service. Family-friendly.

Sofia's Taqueria (Amboy Road).name: Sofia's Taqueria (Amboy Road)
Sofia's Taqueria (Amboy Road).note: Same menu as Bay Street location. Serves Bay Terrace, Eltingville, Annadale corridor. Kids taco options, family-friendly, casual atmosphere.

Patrizia's of Staten Island (Amboy Rd).name: Patrizia's of Staten Island (Amboy Rd)
Patrizia's of Staten Island (Amboy Rd).note: Popular Italian family chain. Pasta under $25: penne vodka $18.99, gnocchi $20.99, fusilli $22.99. Chicken entrees: pollo parmigiana/francese/marsala $21.99. Grilled meats/seafood exceed $25. Kids men

Di Di Restaurant.name: Di Di Restaurant
Di Di Restaurant.note: Unique Chinese and Tex-Mex hybrid. 20+ year neighborhood institution. Chicken dishes $10.84, steak burritos $14.46, combination platters $13–$14.

Da Damaso.name: Da Damaso
Da Damaso.note: Authentic Neapolitan Italian with burgers and panini. Spaghetti carbonara $22, lasagna $25, chicken scaloppine $24, grilled sausage $18. Opened July 2025.

Rossville Pizza.name: Rossville Pizza
Rossville Pizza.note: Independent neighborhood pizza place in Rossville. Sicilian special pizza $10. Very family-friendly, affordable.

China Chalet 312.name: China Chalet 312
China Chalet 312.note: Family Chinese restaurant serving the Annadale/Eltingville corridor. Soups $4.95–$11.95, chicken entrees ~$12, seafood $12–$17. Full menu online.
